_readme: Unseen generalization probe (FAQ A4). 10 scenarios NOT in the student kit, written by the team in the style of the kit's SIIS articles to cover the brief's domains the kit barely touches (Camera, Battery, Performance). Used by scripts/benchmark.py for the cold-path latency sample (N=30 with the 20 kit rows) and to check that unseen SIIS payloads produce valid, non-empty plans. Not used for training or prompt examples.

scenarios.query: my galaxy camera photos come out blurry even when I hold still

siis_response.title: Blurry photos on Galaxy camera
siis_response.content:
If photos from your Galaxy camera look blurry, try the following.

Clean the camera lens
Wipe the rear camera lens with a soft, lint-free cloth. Remove any case or film that covers the lens.

Turn on Scene optimizer
Open the Camera app. Tap the Settings icon. Turn on Scene optimizer so the camera adjusts focus and exposure automatically.

Clear the Camera app cache
Open Settings. Tap Apps. Select Camera. Tap Storage, then tap Clear cache.

Restart your phone
Press and hold the Side key and Volume down key, then tap Restart.

scenarios.query: camera app says Warning Camera failed and closes

siis_response.title: Camera failed error message
siis_response.content:
When the Camera app shows 'Warning: Camera failed', follow these steps.

Force stop the Camera app
Open Settings, tap Apps, select Camera, and tap Force stop. Open the Camera app again.

Reset camera settings
Open the Camera app, tap the Settings icon, scroll down and tap Reset settings, then tap Reset.

Boot into Safe mode
Press and hold the Side key, touch and hold Power off, then tap Safe mode. If the camera works in Safe mode, a downloaded app is causing the issue.

Visit a service center
If the error continues, contact Samsung Support or visit an authorized service center.

scenarios.query: battery drops like 30 percent overnight while I'm sleeping

siis_response.title: Battery drains overnight
siis_response.content:
If your battery drains quickly while the phone is idle, check the following.

Turn on Power saving
Open Settings. Tap Battery. Turn on Power saving.

Put unused apps to sleep
Open Settings, tap Battery, tap Background usage limits, then turn on Put unused apps to sleep.

Turn off Wi-Fi scanning
Open Settings, tap Connections, tap More connection settings, tap Nearby device scanning and turn it off.

Update your software
Open Settings, tap Software update, then tap Download and install.

scenarios.query: phone takes forever to charge now, fast charging not working

siis_response.title: Fast charging not working
siis_response.content:
If fast charging stops working, try these steps.

Check the charger and cable
Use the original Samsung charger and USB cable. Inspect the cable for damage and try a different wall outlet.

Clean the charging port
Turn off the device and gently remove dust or lint from the USB port with a soft brush.

Turn on Fast charging
Open Settings. Tap Battery. Tap Charging settings. Turn on Fast charging.

Restart the device
Press and hold the Side key and Volume down key, then tap Restart.

scenarios.query: my phone got really slow and laggy after the update

siis_response.title: Device running slowly
siis_response.content:
If your Galaxy phone is slow after an update, try these solutions.

Close apps running in the background
Tap the Recent apps button and tap Close all.

Free up storage
Open Settings, tap Battery and device care, tap Storage, and delete files you no longer need.

Optimize your device
Open Settings, tap Battery and device care, then tap Optimize now.

Wipe the cache partition
Turn off the phone. Press and hold Volume up and Side key to enter Recovery mode, select Wipe cache partition, then select Reboot system now.

scenarios.query: instagram keeps crashing every time I open it

siis_response.title: App keeps stopping
siis_response.content:
If an app keeps closing or shows 'App has stopped', try the following.

Clear the app cache
Open Settings, tap Apps, select the app, tap Storage, and tap Clear cache.

Update the app
Open Galaxy Store or Play Store, search for the app, and tap Update.

Reinstall the app
Touch and hold the app icon, tap Uninstall, then install it again from the store.

Restart the phone
Press and hold the Side key and Volume down key, then tap Restart.

scenarios.query: screen is too dim outside and I can't read anything

siis_response.title: Screen too dark in sunlight
siis_response.content:
If the screen is hard to read outdoors, adjust these display settings.

Adjust brightness
Open Settings, tap Display, and drag the Brightness slider to the right.

Turn on Adaptive brightness
Open Settings, tap Display, and turn on Adaptive brightness so the screen adjusts to your surroundings.

Turn on Extra brightness
Open Settings, tap Display, and turn on Extra brightness.

Turn off Power saving
Power saving can limit brightness. Open Settings, tap Battery, and turn off Power saving.

scenarios.query: whites on my screen look yellow, how do I fix the colors

siis_response.title: Screen colors look warm or yellow
siis_response.content:
If the screen looks yellow or the colors seem off, check these settings.

Turn off Eye comfort shield
Open Settings, tap Display, and turn off Eye comfort shield.

Change the Screen mode
Open Settings, tap Display, tap Screen mode, and select Vivid. Drag the White balance slider toward Cool.

Turn off Dark mode
Open Settings, tap Display, and select Light.

scenarios.query: screen is tapping things by itself, ghost touches

siis_response.title: Screen responds without touching
siis_response.content:
If the screen registers touches you did not make, try the following.

Remove the screen protector
Take off any screen protector or case that presses on the edges of the screen, and clean the display with a soft cloth.

Turn off Touch sensitivity
Open Settings, tap Display, and turn off Touch sensitivity.

Turn on Accidental touch protection
Open Settings, tap Display, and turn on Accidental touch protection.

Factory reset
Back up your data, then open Settings, tap General management, tap Reset, and tap Factory data reset.

scenarios.query: galaxy buds keep disconnecting from my phone

siis_response.title: Bluetooth device keeps disconnecting
siis_response.content:
If your Bluetooth earbuds or speaker keep disconnecting, try these steps.

Turn Bluetooth off and on
Open Settings, tap Connections, tap Bluetooth, turn it off, wait a few seconds, and turn it on again.

Forget and pair again
Open Settings, tap Connections, tap Bluetooth, tap the Settings icon next to the device, tap Unpair, then pair the device again.

Turn off Power saving
Open Settings, tap Battery, and turn off Power saving.

Charge the earbuds
Place the earbuds in the charging case and charge them fully.
